duas.title: For Parents
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

duas.title: For Righteous Spouse and Children
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
duas.translation: Our Lord! Bless us with pious spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our eyes, and make us models for the righteous.

duas.title: For a Blissful Family
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

duas.title: Asking for a Child
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li mil-ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka samee'ud-du'a
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

duas.title: For Newlyweds
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka wa baraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr
duas.translation: May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, and may He unite you both in goodness.

duas.title: For a Newborn Child
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: U'eedhuka bi kalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.translation: I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and harmful creature and from every envious evil eye.
